name: Kimi K3 Photonic Chip Architecture & Driver Workbench
description: Silicon photonics accelerator design for Kimi K3 LLM inference with hardware-stored non-volatile optical weights, high-bandwidth optical interconnects, low-latency WDM matrix computing, complete Verilog RTL & Verilog-A EDA fabrication tapeout suite, interactive optical DRC quality assurance checklist, interactive BAR0 MMIO Register Map viewer, optical loss budget simulator, and C++/Kernel driver suite.
